title: Path-Minimality for Positive $p$-Energies, Laplacian-Type Spectra, and Line Graphs
summary: We derive several applications of the path-minimality theorem for adjacency $p$-energy proved in the companion paper. First, we prove the sharp inequality $$ \mathcal E_p^+(G)\ge \mathcal E_p^+(P_n), $$ where $P_n$ is the path on $n$ vertices, in three settings: connected bipartite graphs for every real $p\ge2$, all connected graphs for every odd integer $p\ge3$, and all connected graphs for $p=4$. Second, using subdivision graphs, we prove path-minimality for Laplacian and signless Laplacian-type spectral sums, including power sums, Estrada-type quantities, resolvent energies, and thresholded tails. Third, we prove an edge-count second-order stop-loss comparison for the signless Laplacian above the threshold $2$. This yields the sharp line-graph inequality $$ \mathcal E_p^+(\mathcal L(G))\ge \mathcal E_p^+(P_m) $$ for every connected graph $G$ with $m$ edges and every real $p\ge2$.
comment: Standalone companion paper split from arXiv:2605.22730v1. This paper contains the applications and further consequences formerly included in the comprehensive v1 version; the revised focused main paper appears as arXiv:2605.22730v2

AI.tldr: 由 companion paper 的 path-minimality 定理导出多个应用，证明路 $P_n$ 在 adjacency $p$-energy、Laplacian 型谱和与 line graph 能量下的 sharp 极小性。
AI.motivation: 图的 $p$-energy 与 Laplacian 型谱量的极小图刻画是谱图论的基本问题。
AI.method: 用 adjacency $p$-energy 的 path-minimality 定理，配合 subdivision graph 与 signless Laplacian 的 second-order stop-loss 比较。
AI.result: $\mathcal E_p^+(G)\ge\mathcal E_p^+(P_n)$（连通二部图 $p\ge2$、所有连通图 $p$ 为奇整数 $\ge3$ 或 $p=4$）；Laplacian/signless Laplacian 型谱和亦 path-minimal；line graph 不等式 $\mathcal E_p^+(\mathcal L(G))\ge\mathcal E_p^+(P_m)$（$m$ 条边、$p\ge2$）。
AI.conclusion: 路在多种 $p$-energy 与谱和意义下是极小图，line graph 情形亦然。
AI.future_work: 扩大成立的 $p$ 范围（如所有实 $p\ge2$）；刻画极大图。

title: On the completion of $ε$-dense partial Latin squares
summary: A partial Latin square of order $n$ is called $ε$-dense if each row and each column contains at most $εn$ filled cells, and each symbol occurs at most $εn$ times. A partial Latin square is said to be completable if its empty cells can be filled to obtain a Latin square. Daykin and Häggkvist conjectured that every $\frac{1}{4}$-dense partial Latin square is completable. In this paper, we show that for all sufficiently large integers $n$, every $\frac{2}{25}$-dense partial Latin square of order $n$ is completable. The proof is obtained by establishing that there exists an $η> 0$ such that every triangle-divisible balanced tripartite graph on $3n$ vertices with partite minimum degree at least $(\frac{23}{25}-η)n$ admits a fractional triangle decomposition.

AI.tldr: 证明所有充分大 $n$ 的 $\frac{2}{25}$-dense partial Latin square 可补全，向 Daykin–Häggkvist 的 $\frac14$-dense 猜想推进。
AI.motivation: Daykin 与 Häggkvist 猜想每个 $\frac14$-dense partial Latin square 可补全；此前密度阈值远低于 $\frac14$。
AI.method: 归约为 tripartite 图的 fractional triangle decomposition：证明存在 $\eta>0$ 使每个 partite 最小度 $\ge(\frac{23}{25}-\eta)n$ 的 triangle-divisible balanced tripartite 图有 fractional triangle decomposition。
AI.result: 充分大 $n$ 时每个 $\frac{2}{25}$-dense partial Latin square 可补全。
AI.conclusion: partial Latin square 补全的密度阈值被推进到 $\frac{2}{25}$。
AI.future_work: 进一步逼近 $\frac14$ 阈值；改进 tripartite 最小度条件。

title: The sharp threshold for rainbow stackings of random edge-colourings
summary: A rainbow stacking of $m$ independent, uniformly random $r$-edge-colourings of $K_n$ is a tuple of vertex permutations that superimposes the colourings such that no two edges of the same colour overlap. The study of the critical palette size $r$ required for the existence of such stackings was recently initiated by Alon, Defant, and Kravitz [Bull. Lond. Math. Soc., 57, 2025], who bounded the phase transition within a constant-order window around $\frac{m\binom{n}{2}}{2\log(n!)}$. We determine the constant term in this transition. For every fixed $m\ge2$ and every function $ω(n)\to\infty$, with high probability there is no rainbow stacking if $$r\le \frac{m\binom{n}{2}}{2\log(n!)}+\frac{2m-1}{6}-\frac{ω(n)}{(\log n)^2},$$ while with high probability there is one if $$r\ge \frac{m\binom{n}{2}}{2\log(n!)}+\frac{2m-1}{6}+\frac{ω(n)}{(\log n)^2}.$$ Our proof combines a chromatic-polynomial expansion for an auxiliary conflict graph with a refined estimate of the associated weighted permutation sum. Our result yields the exact threshold $\Big\lceil \frac{m\binom{n}{2}}{2\log(n!)}+\frac{2m-1}{6}\Big\rceil$ for a density-one set of integers $n$, resolving a problem of Alon, Defant and Kravitz.

AI.tldr: 确定 $m$ 个随机 $r$-边染色 $K_n$ 的 rainbow stacking 存在的 sharp 阈值常数项，解决 Alon–Defant–Kravitz 的问题。
AI.motivation: Alon–Defant–Kravitz 把 rainbow stacking 所需 palette 大小的相变界定在 $\frac{m\binom n2}{2\log(n!)}$ 附近常数窗口内，常数项待定。
AI.method: 对辅助 conflict graph 用 chromatic-polynomial 展开，配合加权 permutation sum 的精细估计。
AI.result: 对每个固定 $m\ge2$，阈值为 $\lceil\frac{m\binom n2}{2\log(n!)}+\frac{2m-1}{6}\rceil$（对密度为一的整数集精确），下/上方 $\frac{2m-1}{6}\mp\omega(n)/(\log n)^2$ 处 whp 无/有 rainbow stacking。
AI.conclusion: rainbow stacking 的相变常数项被精确确定，给出 sharp 阈值。
AI.future_work: 处理 $m$ 随 $n$ 增长的情形；补全非密度一的整数 $n$。

title: Supersingular elliptic curves and twisting endomorphisms
summary: We generalize the notion of twisting endomorphisms, first defined by Castryck-Panny-Vercauteran, to the setting of $\mathcal{O}$-oriented supersingular elliptic curves. We give an algorithm to find supersingular elliptic curves over $\mathbb{F}_p$ with a twisting endomorphism of prime degree $\ell$, and we use it to compute a basis of their full endomorphism rings.

AI.tldr: 将 twisting endomorphism 推广到 $\mathcal O$-oriented supersingular elliptic curve，并给出寻找带素数次 twisting endomorphism 的曲线及计算其全 endomorphism ring 基的算法。
AI.motivation: twisting endomorphism（Castryck–Panny–Vercauteren 引入）在超奇异同源密码中重要，推广到 oriented 情形有助于结构与计算。
AI.method: 把 twisting endomorphism 推广到 $\mathcal O$-oriented 设置，设计寻找素数次 $\ell$ twisting endomorphism 的曲线的算法。
AI.result: 给出寻找 $\mathbb F_p$ 上带素数次 twisting endomorphism 的超奇异椭圆曲线的算法，并用其计算全 endomorphism ring 的基。
AI.conclusion: twisting endomorphism 在 oriented 超奇异曲线上可算，服务于同源计算。
AI.future_work: 优化算法复杂度；应用于同源密码构造。

title: List-Coloring and Chromatic-Choosability -- A Dynamic Survey
summary: List-coloring, introduced independently by Vizing and by Erdős, Rubin, and Taylor in the 1970s, generalizes ordinary vertex coloring by assigning to each vertex its own set of admissible colors. A graph is chromatic-choosable if its list chromatic number equals its chromatic number. The previous survey on list-coloring by D R Woodall (2001), emphasized defective choosability, the list-coloring conjectures, and different methods used for list-coloring. This survey reviews major developments on list-coloring and chromatic-choosability, with emphasis on graph classes for which equality is known, graph classes exhibiting a nontrivial gap, and the principal methods used to prove such results. The survey covers embedded graphs, perfect graphs, complete bipartite and multipartite graphs, claw-free graphs, line graphs, powers of graphs, graph products, and selected variants of list-coloring.

AI.tldr: 一篇 list-coloring 与 chromatic-choosability 的动态综述，梳理已知相等/存在 gap 的图类与主要证明方法。
AI.motivation: 自 Woodall (2001) 综述以来 list-coloring 有大量新进展，需要更新的系统梳理。
AI.method: 综述性组织：按图类与方法归纳 list chromatic number 与 chromatic number 的关系。
AI.result: 覆盖 embedded graph、perfect graph、完全（多）部图、claw-free graph、line graph、图的幂、图积及若干变体，重点是相等成立与存在非平凡 gap 的图类及主要方法。
AI.conclusion: 为 list-coloring 与 chromatic-choosability 提供了更新的动态综述。
AI.future_work: 持续更新未决图类；补充新方法。

title: Token sliding independent set reconfiguration on graphs with few $P_4$'s
summary: We consider the INDEPENDENT SET RECONFIGURATION problem under the Token Sliding rule. Let $I$ be an independent set of a simple undirected graph $G$. Suppose that each vertex of $I$ has a token placed on it. The tokens are allowed to be moved, one at a time, by sliding along the edges of $G$, so that after each move, the vertices having tokens always form an independent set of $G$. The problem we deal is to decide if we can transform $I$ into $I'$ through a sequence of steps, each of which involves substituting a vertex in the current independent set with one of its neighbours to obtain another independent set. This problem of determining if one independent set of a graph "is reachable" from another independent set of it is known to be PSPACE-hard even for split graphs, planar graphs, and graphs of bounded treewidth. Polynomial time algorithms have been obtained for certain graph classes like trees, interval graphs, claw-free graphs, bipartite permutation graphs, block graphs, and cographs. We present a polynomial time algorithm for the problem on $P_4$-tidy graphs and $(q,q-4)$-graphs, both families of graphs generalizing cographs.

AI.tldr: 给出 Token Sliding 规则下 Independent Set Reconfiguration 在 $P_4$-tidy 图与 $(q,q-4)$-图上的多项式时间算法。
AI.motivation: 该 reconfiguration 问题即使在 split/planar/bounded treewidth 图上 PSPACE-难，仅在若干结构化图类上多项式可解。
AI.method: 利用 $P_4$-tidy 与 $(q,q-4)$-图（均推广 cograph）的模块分解结构设计算法。
AI.result: 在 $P_4$-tidy 图与 $(q,q-4)$-图上多项式时间判定一个独立集能否经 token sliding 变换到另一个。
AI.conclusion: 扩展了 token sliding reconfiguration 多项式可解的图类到 cograph 的推广族。
AI.future_work: 处理更广的少-$P_4$ 图类；研究其他 reconfiguration 规则。

title: The sharp diagonal spectral correlation inequality on the discrete cube
summary: We prove the sharp diagonal spectral correlation conjecture of Friedgut, Kahn, Kalai and Keller, proposed in their Fourier-analytic approach to Chvátal's conjecture. For every pair of increasing Boolean functions $f,g:\{0,1\}^n\to\{0,1\}$, $$\mathrm{Cov}(f,g)\ge4\sum_{\varnothing\ne S\subseteq[n]}|S|\hat{f}(S)^2\hat{g}(S)^2.$$ Thus covariance controls the degree-weighted collision of the two nonconstant Fourier spectra, giving a sharp Fourier strengthening of the Harris--Kleitman inequality. The theorem also implies the unweighted diagonal conjecture of Friedgut--Kahn--Kalai--Keller for an increasing family and a maximal intersecting family. The factor $4$ is optimal, and we determine all equality cases. Apart from pairs whose relevant coordinate sets are disjoint, equality occurs only for a common dictatorship and, up to relabelling coordinates and interchanging $f$ and $g$, for the two-coordinate AND-OR pair $(f,g)=(x_i x_j,\,x_i\vee x_j).$ The main novelty is a correlated four-restriction induction and a sharp endpoint convolution inequality. The usual two-restriction induction behind Harris--Kleitman sees only the parallel restricted pairs and loses the mixed Fourier information needed to control the degree-weighted diagonal spectral energy. We instead couple the four codimension-one restricted pairs with correlation $1/2$; this precise correlation extracts the missing degree-weighted energy as a nonnegative square.

AI.tldr: 证明 Friedgut–Kahn–Kalai–Keller 的 sharp diagonal spectral correlation 猜想：递增 Boolean 函数 $f,g$ 满足 $\mathrm{Cov}(f,g)\ge4\sum_{S\ne\varnothing}|S|\hat f(S)^2\hat g(S)^2$。
AI.motivation: 该猜想源于 FKKK 对 Chvátal 猜想的 Fourier 分析方法，是 Harris–Kleitman 不等式的 sharp Fourier 加强。
AI.method: 用 correlated four-restriction 归纳与 sharp endpoint convolution 不等式，把四个 codimension-1 限制以相关系数 $1/2$ 耦合以提取 degree-weighted 能量。
AI.result: 证明该 sharp 不等式（因子 4 最优），确定全部等号情形（除坐标不交外，仅 common dictatorship 与两坐标 AND-OR 对 $(x_ix_j,x_i\vee x_j)$），并推出 FKKK 的 unweighted diagonal 猜想。
AI.conclusion: covariance 精确控制两个 Fourier 谱的 degree-weighted 碰撞，给出 Harris–Kleitman 的 sharp Fourier 强化。
AI.future_work: 探索非对角版本；应用于 Chvátal 猜想的进一步推进。
